# sigma_api_connector_credential (Resource)

An API-connector credential: outbound auth Sigma uses when an `sigma_api_connector` calls an external HTTP endpoint. Distinct from `sigma_api_credential` (which is OAuth for Sigma's own REST API). The secret in `credential_json` is **write-only** — sent on create/update but never returned by the API, so refresh leaves it unchanged (no drift detection on that field).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Outbound auth Sigma uses when an API connector calls an external HTTP endpoint.
# Distinct from sigma_api_credential (OAuth for Sigma's own REST API).
resource "sigma_api_connector_credential" "example" {
  name      = "example-service-api"
  allowlist = ["*.example.com"]

  # credential_json is write-only: sent on create/update, never read back.
  credential_json = jsonencode({
    authMethod = "basic"
    basic = {
      username = var.service_username
      password = var.service_password
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowlist` (Set of String) Hostname glob patterns the credential may be used against (e.g. `["*.example.com"]`). Must be non-empty; use `["*"]` to allow every host.
- `credential_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON-encoded `credential` object per Sigma's POST /v2/api-credentials oneOf (e.g. `{"authMethod":"basic","basic":{"username":"u","password":"p"}}`). Write-only: never returned by GET.
- `name` (String) Display name of the credential.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `auth_method` (String) Auth method derived from `credential_json` (e.g. `basic`).
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_api_connector_credential.example '<api_connector_credential_id>'
```
